metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods made by anderson-spider.

plugins.name: chatgpt
plugins.description: Ask ChatGPT or generate requested images in a logged-in browser; save results locally.

plugins.name: codex-computer-use
plugins.description: Control native Mac apps through Codex, with per-app approval and /codex-cu on|off.

plugins.name: codex-team
plugins.description: Dispatches Codex team agents (developer, analyst, architect) into named Herdr panes with confirmed delivery and short reports.

plugins.name: git-master
plugins.description: Registers git-master, a Haiku subagent for git work (status, branches, commits, rebase, push, pull and merge requests) that the session calls whenever a request is about git.

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: A three-row card above the prompt: model, context, cache and cost; the five-hour and seven-day limits with their pace; the last turn, edits and errors.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Read or change your tailnet through the Tailscale API using the apiKey plugin option.
